payload.description:
As a household member, I want the named development exercise to receive the computer continuation from ComputerTurnJobs, so durability is proven on the live queue rather than only in-process hooks.

Acceptance:
- After luna waits on the browser, the exercise marks the computer running, resumes that turn, and receives one SQS message from ComputerTurnJobs.
- The payload names computer capability and the same turn and job identifiers as POST /resume.
- That job is not received from the cpu TurnJobs queue.
- The household computer is marked stopped again. The turn stays waiting. The received computer message is deleted so the exercise does not leave a pile.
- Staging and production are not exercised this way (no waiting, no computer queue deploy).
payload.title: Named development exercise receives a computer continuation from SQS
